questions.prompt: UTG opens, you are on the button with QQ at 100bb. What is the clear mistake?
questions.explanation: Queens are a value continue against an early open. Folding them is a large error.

questions.prompt: Button opens to 3bb, you are in the big blind with 22 and 100bb. A reasonable plan?

choices.text: Call and play fit-or-fold, looking for a set
Fold. Pairs cannot call a button.

questions.explanation: At 100bb the big blind can call a small button open with a pair and release when it misses.

questions.prompt: Hijack opens, you are in the cutoff with ATo. Which continue is the clear mistake?

choices.text: Calling if you will play fit-or-fold in position
Calling and then stacking off 100bb with ace-high on a blank flop

questions.explanation: ATo can take a flop. It is not a 100bb stack-off with no pair.

questions.prompt: A tight under-the-gun player opens. You are in middle position with JJ. Best default?

choices.text: Fold. Jacks are a small pair.

questions.explanation: Jacks 3-bet an early open for value. They do not need a 100bb jam over a small open, and they do not fold.
